resumo.pergunta_rag: This is the 'objeto' (subject) of a Brazilian public procurement notice, written in Portuguese. Is the public body contracting a bank or financial institution to RUN ITS PAYROLL — that is, to process, manage and pay the salary credits of its public servants ('processamento e gerenciamento de créditos provenientes da folha de pagamento', 'pagamento da folha', 'centralização da folha', 'cessão onerosa do direito de processar a folha')? Judge what is being CONTRACTED, not words that are merely mentioned. Besides `objeto`, `trechos_do_edital` holds pages of the notice itself (file and page number): use them as evidence of what is being contracted.
